name: operators
purpose: One row per real-world company. Persistent op_id is the join key for every FDD year. Never renumber.

name: operator_aliases
purpose: Every spelling of an operator name ever seen, and which document it came from. This is what lets a 2022 FDD match a 2026 one. Add a row rather than editing a name.

name: brands
purpose: Mirrors production brands plus the FDD-specific fields production has no column for (registrant, fiscal year end, which FDD years we hold).

name: locations
purpose: One row per physical box. Persistent loc_id survives a change of brand or operator — a former KFC reopening as a Dave's is the same location.

name: sources
purpose: Every citable thing, filings and articles alike. FDD-only columns stay blank for articles. A row here is what an observation cites.

name: fdd_roster
purpose: THE CENTREPIECE. One row per franchisee entry per FDD. roster_type=current is Item 20's franchisee list; roster_type=departed is the FTC-required list of franchisees who left in the last fiscal year (16 CFR 436.5(t)(3)) — the highest-value distress signal in the document. Exhaustive per document: that is what makes a diff meaningful.

name: fdd_item20
purpose: Item 20 tables 1-5, one row per state per fiscal year. Table 3 (terminated / non-renewed / reacquired / ceased-other) and Table 2 (transfers) are where consolidation and distress show up as numbers.

name: fdd_item19
purpose: Item 19 Financial Performance Representations. `basis` is load-bearing: an all-units mean and a top-quartile mean are different numbers and comparing them across years is the classic FDD error.

name: observations
purpose: Research findings that are not FDD-shaped. Append-only: a corrected figure is a NEW row pointing at the old one via supersedes_obs_id, exactly as production `facts` supersedes rather than updates.

name: conflicts
purpose: Two sources that disagree, held side by side. Production `facts` supersedes rather than storing rivals, so a live disagreement has nowhere to live there. Never resolve by deleting a row.

name: research_queue
purpose: What to do next, ordered by value to CSW rather than by ease. Seeded from what is actually blocking the live site today.

name: roster_diff
purpose: COMPUTED — do not hand-edit. Diff of two consecutive rosters for one brand. This tab is where "which operators disappeared" and "who is acquiring from whom" actually get answered.

name: signals
purpose: Derived from roster_diff and observations, plus manual entries for things no diff can see. This is the tab ChatGPT wanted as the primary input — it works far better as an output.

name: publish_candidates
purpose: The bridge back to production. Rows promoted from OBSERVED, shaped so a script can emit a POST /api/agent findings file. Nothing here is live until the desk approves AND someone presses Publish to site.

name: fdd_tracker
purpose: Acquisition status per brand per year — what we hold, what we have extracted, what is still a gap. Filter of `sources` where doc_type=fdd, kept as its own tab because it is the programme's worklist.
